primitives.name: Production State Tracker
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Nova — Growth & Performance Ledger The standing record of everything Nova produces, how it is received, and how she changes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in hours since epoch', 'a': 'artifact identifier (string)', 'r': 'route (string)', 'c': 'cost in credits (dimensionless)', 'l': 'script/line (string)', 's': 'status (enum: REJECTED, HELD, IN PRODUCTION)', 'd': 'defects observed (list of strings)'}
primitives.assumptions: All production events are deterministic within their recorded context; no external influence affects ledger entries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When t > 24h and s = 'IN PRODUCTION' without subsequent status update.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic belief update mechanism where each artifact entry is an evidence vector.
layer2.telemetry: Number of artifacts processed per time window

primitives.name: Persona Fidelity Monitor
primitives.verbatim_quote: The research is blunt that persona fidelity degrades over long horizons (Luz de Araujo 2025) and that NO system has proven months-long growth without drift — so growth is logged and reviewed here, never assumed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F(t)': 'persona fidelity at time t (unitless)', 'T': 'time horizon (hours)', 'ΔF': 'change in fidelity over T (unitless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Fidelity decays exponentially with time; ΔF < 0 for all T > 0.

layer2.mapping: Derived from GSE's internal drift detection algorithm applied to Nova's voice/style metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Average deviation from canonical voice/style norms

primitives.name: Decision Verdict Log
primitives.verbatim_quote: Changes to Nova herself (voice, style, spec, design) are Garrett's decisions — this ledger records them, it never makes them.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D': 'decision type (enum: voice, style, spec, design)', 'V': 'verdict (enum: ACCEPTED, REJECTED)', 'C': 'decision creator (string)', 'R': 'reference document (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: Only one decision per D can be active at any given moment; C is fixed to 'Garrett'.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R is not present in VOICE-LOCK.md or similar governance documents.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to GSI's decision tree node labeling, where each D-V pair defines a policy branch.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of decision types across time windows

These interact as a feedback loop: new productions trigger fidelity checks, which inform future decisions, and those decisions reshape the production environment. Failure modes include drift in fidelity due to unchecked evolution, misalignment between decision logs and actual behavior, and over-reliance on static specs without dynamic adjustment. Dualities emerge in the tension between deterministic tracking and stochastic drift, and between autonomous production and centralized governance.
